text-simple.describes: Three Letter pages of Helvetica text, no annotations

text-search.describes: Search cases: split-font word, hyphenated line break, accents, curly quotes, two columns, character and word spacing, a kerned word, a move and a scaling change inside one line, a kerned pair

text-rotated-90.describes: One Letter page with /Rotate 90; text drawn unrotated in user space

text-rotated-180.describes: One Letter page with /Rotate 180; text drawn unrotated in user space

text-rotated-270.describes: One Letter page with /Rotate 270; text drawn unrotated in user space

text-cjk.describes: Stand-in: an A4 page of Latin Helvetica text. pdf-lib standard fonts have no CJK glyphs, so this file contains no CJK text until a redistributable CJK font is embedded

cropbox-offset.describes: CropBox [50 50 550 750] inside a Letter MediaBox; one Square annotation at user-space (100,100)

mixed-page-sizes.describes: Letter, A4 portrait, A4 landscape, square

annotated-markup.describes: One of each text-markup subtype on page 1

annotated-notes-threaded.describes: A note with two replies (IRT) and one standalone note

annotated-redact.describes: Two unapplied Redact annotations, one text-based with QuadPoints and one area

annotated-shapes.describes: Square, Circle, Line, Polygon, Ink and FreeText

standard-callout.describes: One Letter page with a FreeText callout: /IT /FreeTextCallout, a three-point /CL, /RD, /LE /OpenArrow, red /DA and an /AP drawing box, leader and arrow

callout-xref-stream.describes: standard-callout saved with object streams and an xref stream, so the FreeText sits inside an object stream

callout-incremental.describes: standard-callout plus a hand-written incremental update that rewrites the FreeText with /CL starting at (80, 560)

callout-encrypted.describes: standard-callout AES-256 encrypted by qpdf with an empty user password, so PDF.js opens it but the object reader skips it

callout-bad-xref.describes: standard-callout with startxref 7 bytes off the real xref table; PDF.js rebuilds the cross-reference

note-icon-ap.describes: One Text annotation with /Name /Key and an /AP /N stream

freetext-fonts.describes: Four FreeTexts: /DA font through the annotation /DR (Times-BoldItalic), a bare /Helv, the AcroForm /DR (Courier-Oblique) and a subset Arial-BoldMT

annotated-unsupported.describes: Link, Stamp and FileAttachment, which Inkbar counts but does not import

acroform-basic.describes: A text field and a checkbox (Widget annotations)

form-fields.describes: Every AcroForm field type and flag: text variants, checkbox, radios (named on-states, and two widgets sharing one export value), combo, list, a two-widget field across pages, a rotated page 2, a /DA font named only through /DR, empty signatures on both pages and a reset button

form-scripted.describes: Fields with keystroke, format, validate and calculate scripts (a percent field and a hand-written calculation among them), a mouse-up script that shows a hidden field, JavaScript and non-JavaScript button actions, a reset button whose mouse-up script zeroes qty first, and a document-level script

form-signed.describes: A certified document: /Perms /DocMDP names the signature in "cert" with /P 1 (no changes allowed), plus a text field

form-fieldmdp.describes: No DocMDP; the signed field "approved" has /Lock /Include [amount], so amount is locked and memo stays editable

signed.describes: A text field "name" and a signature field "sig" holding a signature dictionary with /ByteRange and a zero-filled /Contents; it looks signed and verifies nothing

certified.describes: As signed, and certified: the catalog /Perms /DocMDP names the signature, whose DocMDP transform has /P 1 (no changes allowed)

signed-encrypted.describes: signed, AES-256 encrypted by qpdf with an empty user password and owner password "owner-secret"

form-restricted.describes: A text field "name" and a checkbox "agree", AES-256 encrypted by qpdf with an empty user password and permissions that forbid modifying, annotating and filling forms

form-format.describes: A text field "amount" with a format action (AFNumber_Format, dollars, two decimals) and its keystroke action, empty

form-choices.describes: Two list boxes: "size" takes one option (S, M, L; M selected), "colours" takes several (red, green, blue; red selected, with /I [0] beside /V)

form-timer.describes: A text field a document-level app.setInterval bumps every 50 ms and a plain text field, for checking that teardown clears sandbox timers and that timer writes are no undo step

form-uppercase.describes: One text field whose validate script upper-cases the committed value, for checking that a value a script changes is the one kept

form-shared-scripted.describes: A radio group whose two widgets share the export value "A", with a validate script, for checking that the widget chosen is the one kept

form-bare-appearances.describes: A checkbox whose /AP has an on state and no /Off, and a text field with no /AP, for checking that widgets the file draws nothing for are not reported as missing

form-goto.describes: Push buttons with GoTo actions: an explicit destination, a name-tree name, a catalog /Dests name, a name with no destination, a JavaScript action whose /Next is a named GoTo, a GoTo whose /Next is JavaScript, and a JavaScript action whose /Next chain holds a URI, a GoTo and that GoTo's /Next Print

outline.describes: Six pages with an outline. Destinations are 0-based; null left or top is undefined. Tree: Cover (page 0 xyz top 700, left and zoom null); Part One (bold, closed with /Count -2, page 1 fit) > Chapter 1 (page 1 fith top 600), Chapter 2 (name chapter-2 in /Names /Dests: page 1 xyz left 72 top 500, zoom null); Part Two (open, page 2 fitv left 144) > Section A (page 3 fitr x 72 y 100 width 228 height 300), Section B (italic, page 3 fitb); Appendix (name appendix in catalog /Dests: page 4 fit); Website (URI https://example.com/outline); Next page (Named NextPage); Broken (destination to the catalog, not a page: no destination)

links.describes: Link annotations over drawn text, rects as [x1, y1, x2, y2] in user space, pages 0-based. Page 0: [68, 696, 138, 714] explicit xyz to page 1 (left 72, top 600, zoom null); [68, 666, 138, 684] name chapter-3 to page 2 (fit); [68, 636, 144, 654] URI https://example.com/a; [68, 606, 140, 624] URI javascript:alert(1); [68, 576, 140, 594] Named NextPage; [68, 546, 133, 564] GoToR other.pdf; [68, 516, 149, 534] Launch tool.exe; [68, 462, 161, 504] URI https://example.com/wrapped, /QuadPoints one quad per line: [68, 486, 158, 504] and [68, 462, 161, 480]. Page 2 (/Rotate 90): [68, 696, 155, 714] explicit fit to page 0

form-range.describes: A text field whose AFRange_Validate (0 to 10) alerts and refuses a value outside the range, a plain text field, and a button whose JavaScript sets score and whose /Next resets note and submits, for checking that a refused value stays as typed through the alert and that /Next resets and submits run

form-structure.describes: Three text fields (first, second, third, in that /Annots and top-to-bottom order) on a page with /Tabs S, whose structure tree (Document > Sect > Form > OBJR, one Form also holding an MCID) lists third, then first, and leaves second out; a second /Tabs S page has no fields

incremental-saved.describes: Two revisions: a base file plus one hand-written incremental update (xref section with /Prev) that adds a Highlight

object-streams.describes: Saved with object streams and an xref stream

encrypted-aes.describes: AES-256 encrypted by qpdf, user password "inkbar"

encrypted-rc4.describes: 128-bit RC4 encrypted by qpdf, user password "inkbar"

malformed-truncated.describes: First 40% of a valid file; no xref, no trailer

malformed-missing-xref.describes: Copy of text-simple with the xref table and startxref removed; readers must rebuild the cross-reference by scanning

scanned-no-text.describes: Stand-in for a scan: a grey rectangle with no image and no text layer

userunit-2.describes: Copy of text-simple with /UserUnit 2 on every page, so each page renders at twice its point size

saved-annotations.describes: text-simple with one annotation of every type Inkbar draws (a hidden reply among them, a square on page 2), written by the engine with each one's saved data and rewritten; saved-annotations.annotations.json lists them as the session had them

saved-incremental.describes: The annotations of saved-annotations written into text-simple and saved incrementally; saved-incremental.annotations.json lists them

saved-tampered.describes: text-simple with three annotations Inkbar wrote: a square as written, a circle whose saved data is broken JSON, and a line whose saved data records a /Rect 5 points right of the one written; only the square lifts

saved-encrypted.describes: encrypted-aes with a square and a note Inkbar wrote, rewritten and still encrypted (user password "inkbar"), so core's reader cannot see their saved data

saved-signed.describes: form-fields with an image signature Inkbar wrote whose saved data says it signs the empty field "sig"

saved-replied.describes: text-simple with two notes, a reply to the first and a square, all written by Inkbar, then changed as another program would: a reply to the first note that holds nothing of Inkbar's, and a /Popup on the second; only the square lifts; saved-replied.annotations.json lists what Inkbar wrote

redact-text.describes: SECRET-ALPHA and KEEP-BETA on one line of Helvetica, with a region over the first; the trailer has /Info

redact-image-flate.describes: A Flate RGB image of 20 by 10 samples over x 100..300, y 100..200: columns 0 to 9 and 19 red, the rest green; the region covers the left half

redact-path.describes: A red filled star around (150, 150), 60 pt to its points, with the region over its middle (x and y 120..180), and a blue square at x 260..320, y 120..180

redact-annotations.describes: Under the region (x 40..240, y 150..250) a stamp drawing SECRET-STAMP, the widget of text field "hidden" holding SECRET-DELTA, and a note saying SECRET-NOTE whose pop-up lies outside it; text field "kept" has its widget below the region

redact-foreign-mark.describes: Page 1: HIDDEN-DELTA under the region, KEEP-BETA beside it. Page 2: SECRET-GAMMA under an unapplied Redact annotation from another program, with no /INKB_Gloss

redact-hidden-layer.describes: redact-text without /Info, plus a layer the default configuration hides, drawing LAYER-TEXT at y 100

check-form-text.describes: SECRET-ALPHA drawn by a Form XObject under the region, KEEP-BETA beside it in the page content; nothing redacted

check-inline-image.describes: A 4 by 4 grey inline image, a checkerboard of two values, over x 100..200, y 100..200; the region covers its left half; nothing redacted

check-pattern-text.describes: The region filled with a tiling pattern whose cell draws SECRET-ALPHA, KEEP-BETA beside it in the page content; nothing redacted

bad-black-box.describes: SECRET-DELTA with a black rectangle drawn over it (x 45..215, y 190..225) in the page content, KEEP-BETA beside it

bad-unapplied.describes: SECRET-GAMMA under a Redact annotation (x 45..215, y 190..225) that was never applied, KEEP-BETA beside it

bad-appended.describes: Two revisions: the first draws SECRET-ZETA and KEEP-BETA, the appended second draws KEEP-BETA alone; the first content stream stays in the bytes

check-image.describes: A Flate RGB image of 20 by 10 samples over x 100..300, y 100..200, its colour changing from sample to sample; the region covers its left half; nothing redacted

redact-text-composite.describes: SECRET-ALPHA at x 50..218 and KEEP-BETA at x 250..376 in an embedded TrueType font (a subset of Ahem) under a Type0 font with Identity-H codes equal to Unicode values; the region is over the first

redact-text-type3.describes: SECRET-ALPHA at x 50..194 and KEEP-BETA at x 250..358 in a Type 3 font whose glyphs are filled squares; the region is over the first

redact-text-nested-form.describes: SECRET-ALPHA drawn by a form inside a form (shifted 10 pt right by the outer one) under the region, KEEP-BETA in the page content

redact-text-shared-form.describes: Two pages that each draw one form holding SECRET-ALPHA, and KEEP-BETA in their own content; the region is on the first page only, so the second must still show SECRET-ALPHA

redact-text-clip.describes: SECRET-ALPHA in text rendering mode 7, a clipping path that a magenta rectangle (x 40..280, y 185..230) then fills, and KEEP-BETA beside it; the region is over the clipping text

redact-text-rotated.describes: SECRET-ALPHA on a baseline turned 30 degrees about (60, 120), under a region turned with it; KEEP-GAMMA on the turned baseline 40 pt above, partly inside the bounding box of the region and outside the region; KEEP-BETA level at (250, 60)

redact-text-vertical.describes: SECRET-ALPHA and KEEP-BETA written top to bottom in the Ahem subset with Identity-V codes, from y 280 at x 100 and x 300; the region is over the first column

redact-text-half-word.describes: KEEP-SECRET in one string of Helvetica, with the region from x 110, where its S starts, to x 215

redact-image-jpeg.describes: A 64 by 32 JPEG (4:2:0, quality 90; a different magenta for every sample under the region, green beside it) over x 100..292, y 100..196: content in samples 4..27 across under the region (x 90..198), content in samples 36..59 beside it

redact-image-jpx.describes: A 64 by 32 JPEG 2000 image (a different magenta for every sample under the region, green beside it) over x 100..292, y 100..196: content in samples 4..27 across under the region (x 90..198), content in samples 36..59 beside it

redact-image-ccitt.describes: A 64 by 32 CCITT Group 4 image (black squares under the region, a black block beside it) over x 100..292, y 100..196: content in samples 4..27 across under the region (x 90..198), content in samples 36..59 beside it

redact-image-1bit.describes: A 64 by 32 Flate grey image of 1 bit a sample (black squares under the region, a black block beside it) over x 100..292, y 100..196: content in samples 4..27 across under the region (x 90..198), content in samples 36..59 beside it

redact-image-jbig2.describes: A 399 by 400 JBIG2 image from PDFium's tests (two dots at the left, strokes to their right) over x 100..300, y 50..250; the region (x 110..160) covers the dots

redact-image-stencil.describes: A 64 by 32 stencil mask painted magenta (squares under the region, a block beside it) over x 100..292, y 100..196: content in samples 4..27 across under the region (x 90..198), content in samples 36..59 beside it

redact-image-smask.describes: A 64 by 32 Flate RGB image (varied magentas under the region, green beside it) with a /SMask that is a checkerboard of two opacities under the region and opaque elsewhere, over x 100..292, y 100..196: content in samples 4..27 across under the region (x 90..198), content in samples 36..59 beside it

redact-image-mask.describes: A 64 by 32 Flate RGB image (varied magentas under the region, green beside it) with a stream /Mask that masks every third sample under the region, over x 100..292, y 100..196: content in samples 4..27 across under the region (x 90..198), content in samples 36..59 beside it

redact-image-shared.describes: One 64 by 32 Flate RGB image (varied magentas under the region, green beside it) drawn on two pages over x 100..292, y 100..196: content in samples 4..27 across under the region (x 90..198), content in samples 36..59 beside it; the region is on the first page only, so the second must still show the whole image

redact-image-rotated.describes: The colour pattern of redact-image-shared turned 30 degrees about (120, 60), green only from sample 48 across, with KEEP-BETA at (250, 25); the region is the image's left half (up to a third of the way into sample 32), turned with it. The apply blanks the samples in the region's bounding box on the page, which reaches sample 47, so the green starts past it

redact-image-skewed.describes: The colour pattern of redact-image-shared skewed: its top edge 15 pt right of its bottom edge, over x 100..307, y 100..196; the region (x 90..203) covers the content under it, which ends by x 197.2, and the content beside it starts at x 209.9

redact-drawing-fill.describes: A magenta quadrilateral wholly under the region (x and y 110..190) and a blue square at x 260..320, y 120..180

redact-drawing-stroke.describes: A magenta line 4 pt wide from (60, 150) through the region (x 110..190, y 110..190) to (330, 150), and a blue line at y 240

redact-drawing-shading.describes: An axial magenta shading painted through a clip of x and y 125..175, under the region (x and y 110..190), and a blue one through a clip of x 260..320, y 120..180

redact-drawing-pattern.describes: A square (x and y 120..180) under the region filled with a tiling pattern whose 20 pt cell draws a magenta triangle, and a blue square at x 260..320

redact-page-rotate-90.describes: redact-text on a page with /Rotate 90; the region is in user space

redact-page-rotate-270.describes: redact-text on a page with /Rotate 270; the region is in user space

redact-page-cropbox.describes: A 600 by 500 page cropped to x 100..500, y 100..400, with SECRET-ALPHA at (150, 300) under the region and KEEP-BETA at (350, 300)

redact-page-no-contents.describes: A page with no /Contents and one stamp, at x 60..210, y 180..220, whose appearance draws SECRET-STAMP; the region (x 40..240, y 150..250) covers the stamp

redact-copy-thumbnail.describes: redact-text whose page has a /Thumb image of it at a tenth of its size: on the row of the line, the samples where each word lies are the bytes of the word, on white

redact-copy-pieceinfo.describes: redact-text whose page has /PieceInfo, private application data holding SECRET-OMEGA

redact-copy-xmp.describes: redact-text with XMP metadata on the catalog and on the page, each holding a JPEG preview in xmp:Thumbnails

redact-annotation-loupe.describes: redact-text with a loupe beside the region: a square annotation at x 220..380, y 40..160 whose appearance draws a copy of the page (tagged /INKB_PageCopy) at twice its size, centred on the start of SECRET-ALPHA
redact-annotation-loupe.refused: the loupe's appearance holds a copy of the page as it was, which the apply does not change; Inkbar writes its own loupes again after the apply

redact-file-encrypted.describes: redact-text encrypted with AES-128; the user password is "inkbar". It also holds a content stream nothing refers to, drawing ORPHAN-OMEGA

redact-file-signed.describes: redact-text with a signature field (widget at x 300..380, y 40..80) holding a signature dictionary whose /Contents is zeros: it looks signed and verifies against nothing

redact-file-revisions.describes: Two revisions: the first draws SECRET-ZETA and KEEP-BETA, the appended second draws SECRET-ALPHA under the region and KEEP-BETA; the first content stream stays in the bytes

redact-file-hidden-layer.describes: redact-text plus HIDDEN-OMEGA at (50, 170) in a layer the default configuration hides; the region (x 45..215, y 160..225) covers both

redact-file-attachment.describes: redact-text with an attached file holding SECRET-OMEGA in /EmbeddedFiles and a file attachment annotation (x 340..360, y 40..60) holding SECRET-SIGMA

redact-file-script.describes: redact-text with scripts holding SECRET-OMEGA in /Names /JavaScript, SECRET-SIGMA in the /OpenAction and SECRET-KAPPA in the page's /AA

redact-text-pattern.describes: A band at x 20..380, y 170..240 filled with a tiling pattern whose one cell, the size of the page, is grey with SECRET-ALPHA at (50, 200), under the region; KEEP-BETA at (300, 100) in the page content
redact-text-pattern.refused: the redaction cuts the band but does not enter the pattern, so the cell still holds the text under the region, and the check counts it

redact-drawing-pattern-past-mark.describes: A band at x 20..380, y 100..200 filled with a tiling pattern whose one cell, the size of the page, draws a magenta quadrilateral under the region (x and y 110..190) and a blue square at x 260..320, y 120..180 beside it
redact-drawing-pattern-past-mark.leaks: the apply cuts a hole in the band but leaves the pattern, whose cell still draws the quadrilateral under the region, and the check does not count vector drawing inside a pattern
